Eaton does not report a consolidated operating-income subtotal. Operating income is derived as reported net sales less cost of products sold, selling/administrative expense and research/development expense. Separate net interest, business-disposal gains and other expense/income net are excluded. Other expense/income contains mixed operating and nonoperating items, so this mapping is a disclosed comparability limitation; no vendor/segment adjusted-profit measure is used.
